nodes.Name: Point
nodes.DocComment: A Point is an X, Y coordinate in the data being plotted.

nodes.Name: Graph
nodes.DocComment: A Graph is a graph to draw as SVG.

nodes.Name: alphaNorm
nodes.ValueLiteral: flag.Float64("alphanorm", 0.1, "alpha for a single norm line")

nodes.Name: parseFloats
nodes.DocComment:
parseFloats parses rec[1:] as floating point values.
If a field is the empty string, it is represented as +Inf.

nodes.Name: floatsToLine
nodes.DocComment: floatsToLine converts a sequence of floats into a line, ignoring missing (infinite) values.

nodes.Name: svgHeader
SVGPoint
nodes.DocComment:
An SVGPoint is a point in the SVG image, in pixel units,
with Y increasing down the page.

nodes.Name: pt
nodes.DocComment: pt converts an x, y data value (such as from a Point) to an SVGPoint.

nodes.Name: SVG
nodes.DocComment: SVG returns the SVG text for the graph.
